title: Measures to Keep Cost of Food at Coffee Shops Affordable
what_it_is: Measures to Keep Cost of Food at Coffee Shops Affordable

sections.label: HDB coffee shop supply
sections.summary: HDB ensures a good supply of coffee shops in its estates to keep food prices competitive, with close to 750 built and more planned.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: To provide residents with access to affordable food options, the Housing and Development Board (HDB) ensures that there is a good supply of coffee shops in HDB estates to maintain healthy price competition.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: There are presently close to 750 HDB-built coffee shops, of which 70 were completed in the last five years.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: A further 31 are in the pipeline and will be completed in the next five years.

sections.label: Price-Quality Method tendering
sections.summary: HDB piloted the Price-Quality Method, where quality scores 50%, and will replace e-bidding with PQM for all coffee shops later this year.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: For example, instead of simply awarding to the highest price bids, HDB has been piloting the use of the Price-Quality Method (PQM) to tender out several coffee shops.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: Under the PQM, quality score accounts for 50% of the evaluation and operators with affordable food options will score higher.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: That is why HDB recently awarded a coffee shop in Choa Chu Kang to a food operator with affordable food options and with initiatives to improve productivity, even though their rental bid was 40% lower than the highest bid.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: We have seen good outcomes from this tendering approach.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: So, I am happy to share that HDB will be replacing the existing e-bidding system with the PQM tender for all coffee shops later this year.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: I met up with the coffee shop operator.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: They told me that because of e-bidding, some of them are not experienced, just because they want to come into business, they put up a higher price and then when they come in, they cannot survive, they close down.
